ReleaseNotes: Added configurable technician Write-Up Flags and Refer To destinations.
Added automatic DB Correction Needed detection for equipment replacements and IP-address changes.
Added configurable Dispatch closeout checklist definitions with Always, Write-Up Flag, and Refer To triggers.
Added persistent shared Dispatch closeout checklists with required and optional items, completion user, and completion time.
Redesigned Dispatch Tasks with expandable rows containing submitted write-ups, flags, referrals, and closeout checklist items.
Added API-enforced ticket closure rules so required Dispatch closeout items must be completed before closing.
Added activity-aware automatic refresh to Dispatch Tasks while preserving active dispatcher work.
Improved Site Dashboard RX searching, cached fallback behavior, write-up workflow, and theme presentation.
